# Cogentiq by Fractal

> Cogentiq is Fractal's enterprise agentic AI platform for building, running and governing enterprise agents on the systems you already run. It works in five steps: connect, contextualize, build, run and govern. It deploys natively on AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.

Draft for the root of fractal.ai (https://fractal.ai/llms.txt), covering the Cogentiq product family. It gives AI assistants and answer engines a plain-text summary and the pages to read first.

## What Cogentiq is

- [Cogentiq: Enterprise Agentic AI Platform](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq/): the product page. Why agent pilots stall (reach, trust, scale), the five platform steps, the enterprise ontology, governance on every run, cloud deployment, solution packs and the FAQ.
- Connect: secure connectors, retrieval and an MCP gateway over structured and unstructured data. Systems of record are read in place, not copied.
- Contextualize (Cogentiq Context): one enterprise ontology of glossaries, data bindings, tools, prompts and skills, built in three layers (domain, organization, solution) and reused by every agent.
- Build: a low-code canvas for domain experts and a pro-code SDK on one object model.
- Run: multi-agent orchestration, stateful execution and approval gates by named role.
- Govern: one control plane with identity (SSO, RBAC), policy, guardrails, human checkpoints, evaluation and an audit trail on every run.
- Monitor: runs, success rate, latency, quality from live evaluations, and cost per agent, team and workspace, with alerts when an agent drifts, slows down or is blocked.
- Observe: a trace of every run, showing each agent step, tool call and hand-off, the sources behind each answer, the policy checks passed and who approved.
- Deployment: model and cloud agnostic. Available in AWS Marketplace in the AI Agents and Tools category.

## Cogentiq solutions

- [Cogentiq Invoice to Cash](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-invoice-to-cash/): billing, collections and deduction management.
- [Cogentiq Procure Assist](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-procure-assist/): agentic AI for sourcing and procurement.
- [Cogentiq CX](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-cx/): self-service, real-time assistance for customer service teams, and quality review.
- [Cogentiq Underwriting](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-underwriting/): agentic AI for P&C underwriting.
- [Cogentiq Underwriting for financial services](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-underwriting-financial-services/)
- [Cogentiq eCommerce](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-ecommerce/): a foresight and decision engine for CPG e-commerce.
- [Cogentiq Digital Commerce](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-digital-commerce/)
- [Cogentiq Innovation](https://fractal.ai/products/cogentiq-innovation/): from idea to shelf, faster.
- [Cogentiq Campaign Assist](https://fractal.ai/products/showcase/cogentiq-campaign-assist)
